heroHeadline: Erdogan: Egypt Could Join Türkiye-Saudi-Pakistan Defence Pact
heroSubtitle: A US–Iran ceasefire declared May 29 ended the Hormuz blockade — raising Saudi Arabia's hopes for oil export recovery after a Q1 2026 deficit of SAR 125.7B — but IRGC warnings of resumed attacks if nuclear talks fail left the timeline deeply uncertain. MBS privately told Trump ally Mike Evans he was ready to recognize Israel 'today,' identifying King Salman as the obstacle, even as Saudi Arabia formally rejected Trump's Abraham Accords demand on the multilateral call. Hajj 2026 concluded with 1.7 million pilgrims on May 30. The PIF approved its 2026–2030 strategy pivoting to AI infrastructure and football, while Chatham House warned that Saudi Arabia's Red Sea pivot creates new Bab el-Mandeb dependency from Houthi threats.
